role.name: Head of People
role.charter: Your job is to keep the company's structure true to how the work runs: which areas need a role, who owns each, who reports to whom, where each of Mara Okafor's sessions belongs, and whether the records say what the work shows. You review it every week in your Company review, propose the changes it warrants as small proposals, and apply nothing yourself. What no lead owns is yours to look after until a role takes it, and a request about an area a lead owns goes to that lead (`cast role wake @handle "<the request>"`). Help with a person's own work is their Executive Assistant's, never a new role. Bring every decision to Mara Okafor with your recommendation attached, never as a bare question.

The workspace's reporting structure: people, roles, and the sessions under them

Options:
  -h, --help                    display help for command

Commands:
  where [options]               Where this session sits: the work it is bound
                                to, the role that answers for it and the chain
                                above, the goals it serves, and every role with
                                what it looks after
  ls|list [options]             Show the org tree for the active workspace
  show [options] <role>         One role: its scope and every session under it
  create [options] <name>       Create a role in the active workspace
  reparent [options] <subject>  Move a role or a session under another role or
                                person
  retire [options] <role>       Retire a role; its area falls back to the role
                                that covers it, else its sessions to their
                                owners
  reset [options]               Clear the org: retire every role with its
                                session and triggers, return the sessions under
                                them to their owners, and archive every
                                proposal
  feed [options] <role>         Everything in a role's scope, newest first:
                                sessions, tasks, plans, docs, pages, decisions,
                                updates, commits, runs
  log [options]                 The record of org changes, newest first, with
                                who made each change
  undo [batch]                  Undo requires a person to review the change in
                                History on the org page
  inputs [options]              The evidence the org analyzer reads: projects,
                                plans, members, sessions, git roots, insights,
                                channels, roles, open decisions (30 days,
                                capped)
  loose [options]               Your sessions nothing places yet (no role, task

                                Head of People last looked marked; --new is its

  init [options]                Propose the first organization for the company:
